drivers.driver: The Company suffers from a conglomerate discount, where its high-growth, high-margin semiconductor equipment franchise is obscured by a disparate, lower-margin industrial portfolio [D01, D05].

Applying a peer-level multiple of 15x to the Precision Machinery segment, compared to the current group EV/EBITDA of 9.87x, reveals significant upside, with an implied per-share value of up to JPY 3,850 [D04, D06].
The Precision Machinery unit faces a clear margin gap, operating at 13.2% compared to pure-play peers like Applied Materials and Lam Research, which achieve margins near 29% [D06].
A strong balance sheet featuring JPY 20.598 billion in net cash provides a hard floor, limiting downside risk to current trading levels of approximately JPY 2,778 [D04].

final.memo:
The Company is a conglomerate whose true value is masked by a disparate set of industrial businesses that overshadow its premier, high-margin semiconductor equipment franchise [D01, D06]. Despite the Precision Machinery unit generating JPY 73.9 billion in orders in Q1 2025, the market continues to penalize the entire entity with a blended industrial multiple of 9.87x EV/EBITDA [D04, D06]. We view this mispricing as a classic conglomerate discount where the market fails to value the secular growth of the semiconductor business independently [D01, D05].

Our sum-of-the-parts analysis suggests a path to JPY 3,850 per share by realizing the value of the Precision Machinery segment at a 15x multiple, aligned with its specialized potential rather than the current group average [D04, D06]. While consolidated operating margins sit at 11.3%, the Precision Machinery unit is currently performing at 13.2% against pure-play benchmarks such as Applied Materials and Lam Research, which demonstrate margins exceeding 28% [D02, D06]. The potential to unlock value through portfolio simplification and margin optimization is significant [D01, D07].

We intend to engage privately with the Board to initiate a strategic review of the corporate structure, advocating for the separation of the Precision Machinery business to unlock shareholder value [D01, D06]. We believe that providing a clear path for capital allocation and operational discipline will allow the market to re-rate the semiconductor asset appropriately [D07]. Our firm has a long history of constructive engagement in Japan and we favor a polite, private approach to establish alignment with the Board before considering public escalation [D05].

The downside is protected by a solid balance sheet, including JPY 20.598 billion in net cash, which supports the current stock price of JPY 2,778 as a floor [D04]. We are sizing this position at 5% of NAV, reflecting our conviction in the catalyst, while maintaining a hedge via index puts to manage systemic market risk [D05, D08]. We will monitor order intake and sequential margin expansion closely and are prepared to exit if management demonstrates an inability or unwillingness to address the structural discount [D05, D06].
